title: v0.12.5
excerpt: Added 🧭 Analytics session explorer. Administrators can now open a Sessions tab in Admin Analytics that lists each chat with its tokens, responses, errors and time span, filters them by search, model, token range or sub-agents, and shows a chat's saved replies and tool calls with their timing and outcome, as long as "ENABLE_ADMIN_CHAT_ACCESS" is on. Commit 📑 Pages in notes. Notes can now hold several pages and subpages, which you can add, rename, reorder, move under another page, download, link to and delete from the page tabs, and search results and the model now work with notes page by page. Commit 👀 Live presence in notes. A note now shows who else has it open, and clicking a person jumps to the page and spot they are working on. Commit ✏️ Rename from chat menu. The menu next to an open chat's title now has Rename, which turns the title at the top of the page into a text box, so a chat can be renamed without finding it in the sidebar first. #33177 , #33176 , #33246 , #33339 , #33338 , Commit , Commit 🖼️ Generated images in terminals. When a terminal is selected in a chat, generated and edited images are now also saved to its working folder, so the model can keep working on them with the terminal's tools. Commit 🗃️ Models show chat files. Models can now show a file attached in the chat or stored in an attached knowledge base right in the reply with the built-in display_file tool, which until now only worked for terminal files. #32471 , Commit , Commit 💾 Chat model choice sav
